$comment: Closed source-only producer/consumer contract; schema acceptance is not permission. No old fence mutation, retry, absent-row completion, global completeness claim, proof ceiling increase or automatic non-target reopening.

Target member/pins and scope provider/subject must match. issued < admission <= contact <= retention <= pending <= expires <= issued+3600s; contact-issued <=600s and retention-contact <=600s. Google material selects exactly one token purpose. No timeout, missing row or new grant settles an unknown prior contact.

assignment.$comment: Actual signed assignment selected by exact (holderId,enrollmentSha256), not provider alone. Historical root, native key/boot/role-4 measurements, application ciphertext, KEK and provider TLS roots all independently match.

statement.$comment: Exact24. Literal prepare (never draft). Own nativeOAuthRetiredScopeSuccession.sign/v1; signature domain schema+NUL. NSM nonce SHA256(serverware/native-oauth-retired-scope-succession-attestation/v1+NUL || challenge32 || SHA256(statement) || signature64). Phase input SHA binds exact arguments except native_evidence. Whole original operation <=30s, clipped to grant.

httpResponse.$comment: Complete envelope <=8MiB; actual raw runtime response <=2883584 bytes. No response or result DTO grants effects.

result.$comment: Exact7 with originals9 and observation6; canonical kernel result <=1MiB BEFORE protected effects commit. Raw originals are canonical ASCII strings, never base64. Actual signed response verifies whole request frame/result/configuration. Missing association means unknown, never completion.

recoveryOriginalResponse.$comment: Read-only <=1MiB. Fresh recover native proof observes retained state only. It cannot reconstruct a lost fence/contact acknowledgement, processing nonce or contact authority.

intent.$comment: Direct purpose-selected /oauth/begin#original=base64url(canonical intent), complete <=8MiB including outer helper framing (no generic frame widening). Native independently verifies original root/configuration/signatures, full FENCE request/result/journal/scope/all-before-roots binding, and original grant. Scope closure requires every exact material contact accepted or genuinely accepted-existing before PKCE/fresh PREPARE; no old-purpose conversion. Trusted-host-local controlled-writer receipt is not native TEE custody evidence.

successionBinding.$comment: Private nativeOAuthSuccessionState/v1 uses unchanged21 scalar names plus successionBinding8. Full grant/fence/material originals stay separately retained, not squeezed into private64KiB state. Credential sealing AAD is exact target UUID and N+1.

transport.$comment: Canonical <=384KiB. Actual measured fixed provider TLS determines accepted/rejected/unknown. Neither status DTO nor unchanged/unequal token bytes is isolation authority.
